description: Use when you need what one cloud charges, or what hosts ask on a marketplace, to rent a GPU now. Returns the price per GPU-hour and its type, the last change, the source URL and when it was read. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

chip.description: GPU family, for example H100, A100, H200, B200, B300 or GB200.

price_type.description: On-demand (default) or Spot list price, or a marketplace ask: the lowest (marketplace-ask-low) or highest (marketplace-ask-high) price one host lists that day on a marketplace. An ask is not a list price.

provider.description: Seller: a cloud such as AWS or Azure, or a marketplace such as Lium.

region.description: One region, by code or name, for example us-east-1, eastus or East US. A marketplace's lines are in region marketplace.

name: get-gpu-price
title: Current GPU rental price
